Any suggestions folks please send directly to Gregor, below. Thanks! - Len

-------- Original Message --------
From: Schuurman, Gregor W - DNR <Gregor.S...@wisconsin.gov>


Hi - I use distance sampling to survey Karner blue butterfly populations
in Wisconsin. I'm interested in any article that talks about the growing
use of this method for insect population-estimation.
thanks,
P Gregor Schuurman, PhD

Bureau of Endangered Resources
Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources
